activities.activity_description: Set up Rabbit performance testing tools, execute benchmarks, and document results for XD cluster setup reference.
Add high-level Javadoc descriptions to all modules to clarify their purpose and capabilities.
Configure Maven build to generate and publish Spring XD RPMs to repo.spring.io for direct user download.
Use Kafka's built-in perf-testing utilities to benchmark message bus performance and compare with LinkedIn's baseline metrics.
Update the Spring XD wiki troubleshooting section to explain message header changes affecting 1.0 batch-jobs in 1.1.
